beats.say: Huge green candle. Everyone's posting gains. And you want in right now.
beats.cap: Huge green candle. Everyone's posting gains. And you want in right now.

beats.say: Here's the thing. The candle already moved. Your plan didn't.
beats.cap: Here's the thing: the candle already moved. Your plan didn't.

items.n: you're late to someone else's trade

beats.say: So ask three questions. Is this my setup? Where's my stop? What's my size?
beats.cap: So ask 3 questions: Is this my setup? Where's my stop? What's my size?

beats.say: Can't answer all three in ten seconds? Then it's not a trade. It's a feeling.
beats.cap: Can't answer all 3 in 10 seconds? Then it's not a trade. It's a feeling.

items.n: a feeling is not a plan

beats.say: Missing a move costs you nothing. Chasing one can cost you a lot.
beats.cap: Missing a move costs you nothing. Chasing one can cost you a lot.
beats.sub: chasing one can cost a lot more

title: Huge green candle, you want in? Ask these 3 questions first
caption:
huge green candle and you want in right now? 🕯️ ask 3 questions first: is this my setup, where's my stop, what's my size. no answers, no trade. not financial advice. what's the move you regret chasing? 👇
